projectName: Illovediza Fuerza Spain Municipal RainWater Network

sharedEngine.name: AquaDMRV
sharedEngine.ownership: Shared water, physical-event, quality-management, cryptographic-evidence and climate-accounting engine
sharedEngine.integrationGate: AquaDMRV repository must be readable before mapping actual event schemas, API routes, broker, database, signing keys, chain adapters and QMS services.

jurisdiction.geographyAuthority: INE municipality codes joined to versioned IGN-CNIG municipal polygons

deployment.product: Premium municipal RainWater, subject to legal product classification and authorization
deployment.venueQualificationRule: A football stadium is a municipal anchor only where evidence establishes that it belongs to or is co-located within the same municipal sports complex as a qualified major padel anchor. Tennis is selective and requires documented Ayuntamiento management/significance.

assuranceDomains.invariant: Modelled rainfall or catchment potential must never be reported as measured harvested volume.
A missing, stale, out-of-specification or untraceable required result places the batch on HOLD. A cryptographic proof cannot release a batch.
Rainfall, water volume, bottle sales, sports participation or a blockchain transaction do not independently create carbon credits.
The chain proves integrity and ordering of committed evidence, not the truth of the physical event or the accuracy of the instrument.

streamRequirements.transport: TLS-authenticated event stream; broker and protocol to be aligned with AquaDMRV implementation
streamRequirements.idempotency: Stable eventId and device sequence; duplicate delivery must not create duplicate observations or volumes
streamRequirements.clockPolicy: Retain device-observed time, server-received time and blockchain block time as distinct timestamps
streamRequirements.replayPolicy: Support replay with original event IDs, signatures and source timestamps; never rewrite original observations
streamRequirements.privacyPolicy: Raw telemetry and personal data remain off-chain under access control; only minimum cryptographic commitments and non-sensitive identifiers may be anchored
streamRequirements.signaturePolicy: Illovediza validates signature presence and event integrity fields only. Device signature cryptographic verification and trust/key lifecycle are owned by AquaDMRV after contract alignment.
streamRequirements.hashPolicy: Canonical SHA-256 event envelope is calculated locally; AquaDMRV must verify/recompute on ingestion. A locally computed hash is not a chain anchor.
streamRequirements.persistencePolicy: Illovediza must not create a parallel authoritative event ledger. AquaDMRV remains the system of record; Illovediza stores project identity and references/caches only where permitted by AquaDMRV.
streamRequirements.duplicatePolicy: AquaDMRV must enforce idempotency using eventId and the deviceId/sequenceNumber pair; duplicate deliveries must not increase harvested volume.
streamRequirements.reportingPolicy: Municipal and venue reports are generated from versioned AquaDMRV evidence references and methodology versions. Missing or disconnected data must remain NOT_CONNECTED or PENDING, never zero-as-measured.

regulatoryProfile.candidatePackagedWaterRoute: Spanish prepared packaged drinking water framework may be relevant for water of any origin after authorized treatment; competent-authority confirmation is mandatory before product design or sale.

illovedizaOwns: Spain-specific venue, municipal and product branding
project-specific indicator mapping and climate-finance readiness reports
rOwns: automated municipal/provincial/national report rendering and export
aquaDmrVOwns: device identity, signatures and key lifecycle
QMS parameter specifications and batch hold/release workflow
Merkle commitments and chain transaction/readback receipts
reporting.commonRule: Consumers of the same versioned evidence API and methodology references; no independent shadow DMRV ledger or copied master evidence database.
